targets.primary: mean of the 100 individually background-subtracted, clipped, smoothed, and unit-normalized Lenstool range maps
targets.primary_uncertainty: score every locked prediction against each of the 100 Lenstool range maps
targets.method_disagreement: Jensen-Shannon divergence and Pearson correlation between the Lenstool ensemble-mean and GLAFIC best normalized maps

scoring.no_fresh_selection: All 15 candidates are scored as locked. C0351 alone is judged by the confirmation gates; no fresh winner replaces it.
scoring.parameter_impact: For each frozen one-at-a-time variant, report median delta JS relative to C0351, 16th-84th cluster interval, win fraction, and whether the sign agrees between Lenstool and GLAFIC. Rank absolute median primary delta as impact, not as evidence for a new best formula.
